title: Telecommunications & RF Components
painPoint: 5G base stations and RF infrastructure rely on circulators, isolators, and phase-shifter components where NdFeB magnets provide the critical bias field. Engineers struggle with flux stability under thermal cycling from -40C to 85C, causing insertion loss drift in N42SH and N48SH assemblies. Miniaturization demands tighter magnetic tolerances, yet inconsistent grain alignment in lower-grade magnets creates field non-uniformity that degrades port-to-port isolation. High-power waveguide systems require magnets with coercivity above 955 kA/m to prevent demagnetization from RF heating. Sourcing small-batch, precision-machined neodymium magnets with guaranteed Br consistency and tight dimensional tolerances remains a persistent supply chain bottleneck for RF component manufacturers.
youjiuSolution: YOUJIU delivers precision-engineered NdFeB magnets tailored for RF and telecommunications applications. Our N42SH, N48SH, and N35UH grades maintain stable flux output across extreme temperature ranges, ensuring minimal insertion loss variation in circulator and isolator assemblies. We achieve Br consistency within +/-0.5% per batch through advanced grain-boundary diffusion and tight sintering control. Our CNC-machined miniaturized magnets meet +/-0.05 mm dimensional tolerances for compact 5G phase-shifter designs. With intrinsic coercivity exceeding 955 kA/m, our magnets resist demagnetization under sustained RF thermal loads.
